name: Paradox Idol
source:
Just as the idol group you manage is about to debut, one member quits. You're forced to take his place. Will you become a true K-pop idol?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]

就在你带的偶像团体即将出道时，一名成员退团了。你不得不顶替他的位置。你能成为真正的K-pop偶像吗？
